title: Mathematically Quantifying Non-responsiveness of the 2021 Georgia Congressional Districting Plan
findings: This paper contains no findings related to religion. Its findings are focused on the mathematical and statistical analysis of the 2021 Georgia Congressional Districting Plan, concluding that it is highly non-responsive to shifts in public opinion and shows evidence of partisan gerrymandering through 'packing and cracking' of voters.
